meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: Claude 会先判断计算该在哪执行(内存、原地或远程),再用 DuckDB、Polars 等常驻内核引擎分析 CSV/Parquet/JSON 数据,回答分组、连接、聚合等问题,并报告行数与耗时,也不使用 pandas。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV/Parquet/JSON 数据,或做分组、连接、聚合等操作时触发;没有内核的终端环境也有 CLI 方式兜底。

say.text: 先用 DuckDB 直接查询 data.csv,按地区汇总销售额
say.note: 会返回汇总结果、行数与耗时

say.text: 把这份数据清洗一下,再画一张趋势图
say.note: 绘图前先读可视化参考并做视觉检查

say.text: 这个文件比内存大,用 Polars 流式处理它
say.note: 会限制内存并流式查询,不整份载入

howto.what_en: Claude decides where computation runs (memory, in place, or remote), then analyzes CSV/Parquet/JSON with engines like DuckDB and Polars — group-by, joins, time series — reporting row counts and timing. No pandas, no extra charts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze CSV/Parquet/JSON data or do group-by, joins, aggregation and similar work; a CLI fallback covers harnesses without a kernel.

say_en.text: Query data.csv with DuckDB and sum sales by region
say_en.note: Returns the totals with row counts and timing

say_en.text: Clean this dataset, then plot a trend chart
say_en.note: Reads the visualization guide and does a visual check first

say_en.text: This file is bigger than RAM — process it with Polars streaming
say_en.note: Caps memory and streams instead of loading it all
